hero.headline: Bring PPC reporting and lead signals together
hero.subheadline: How can an agency consolidate cross-channel PPC data and lead scoring into a single dashboard?
hero.risk_reversal: Confirm channel access, lead allowances and your total quote before committing.
hero.answer_snippet: Use a shared reporting workspace for supported ad channels, then assess company-level visitor activity alongside buyer-intent signals. Diginius is one candidate for this workflow. Agree on conversion definitions and lead qualification rules first: a consolidated dashboard does not by itself establish consistent attribution or identify every visitor..

problem_solution.problem: Which campaign data and company signals belong in one decision?
problem_solution.agitation: An agency reporting across Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Meta and LinkedIn can end up with separate exports, conversion definitions and client-fee calculations. Putting those numbers side by side helps review them, but a combined total can still mislead when networks credit the same conversion or use different reporting windows.
problem_solution.solution: Start with one client and one reporting period. Reconcile spend and conversions against each network, then review identifiable company visits separately from confirmed sales leads. Expand only when the team can explain the figures, assign a follow-up owner and show the client what the report does and does not establish.

benefits.benefit_title: Review supported channels in one view
benefits.benefit_description: Diginius lists Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Meta and LinkedIn in its agency offering. Use the shared view to examine campaign activity without treating every network metric as equivalent. Keep channel-level detail available when a client asks why the totals differ.

benefits.benefit_title: Put company activity alongside campaign reporting
benefits.benefit_description: Lead Intelligence can associate website visits with companies where a match is possible. Pages viewed and time on site can help a team decide which accounts merit further investigation. This is a research input, not proof that a named individual clicked an ad or is ready to buy.

benefits.benefit_title: Review budget pacing and client invoices
benefits.benefit_description: The agency page lists budget pacing, white-label reporting, fee calculations and invoice generation. Evaluate those features with one real client agreement: check who owns the budget, how fees are calculated and which amounts appear in client-facing output.

proof_blocks.proof_type: Agency scope and USD seat pricing
proof_blocks.summary: On 14 October 2026, the official agency page lists USD $25 per user per month, or $240 per user per year. It also lists white-label reporting, budget pacing and agency finance features. This seat price does not establish the complete cost of your required lead-intelligence package or unrestricted client-account capacity. Request an itemised quote for your use case.

The official business-pricing page is a separate plan comparison. Its sections do not consistently describe lead allowance periods and trial duration. Do not choose a plan from the supplied draft's quotas. Ask Diginius to confirm the current lead, contact and Bombora allowances, their reset periods, trial terms and taxes for your billing region in writing.

Diginius describes tracking IP addresses and browsing activity, then matching a company where possible. A company match can support account research; it does not establish the identity of a particular visitor, consent to contact them or a verified connection between one ad click and a sale.

Diginius describes Lead Intelligence and Bombora intent as inputs for identifying and prioritising prospective accounts. Treat intent as a signal to investigate alongside customer fit and observed activity. No hands-on lead-quality, attribution or conversion-rate testing was performed for this article.

AgencyAnalytics publishes a per-client pricing approach. Compare the total quote, required integrations, client reporting experience and team access for the same scope. This article does not make a price-equivalent comparison or conclude that one product is cheaper.

proof_blocks.proof_type: Alternative: control over the reporting destination
proof_blocks.summary: Supermetrics documentation covers destinations including Google Sheets, Looker Studio, Excel and BigQuery. Consider this approach when your team wants to assemble reporting in those tools. Account for connector coverage, transformation work and maintenance; this is a workflow distinction, not a claim that either product lacks all of the other's capabilities.

how_it_works.title: Connect one representative client
how_it_works.description: List the advertising accounts you need and confirm that the chosen package supports them. Give the integration only the access your agency is authorised to grant. Check the available history, refresh frequency and connection process with Diginius before planning a migration; this review does not verify a particular OAuth flow or historical-data window.

how_it_works.title: Agree on the reporting definitions
how_it_works.description: Choose a reporting period, a currency, and the conversion definition. Compare each connected channel's spend and conversions with its native report before combining figures. Keep attribution windows visible. Calculate CPA only against the agreed conversion count, and avoid calling a combined figure cross-platform impression share or CRM-normalised ROAS without a documented method..

how_it_works.title: Separate visitor signals from qualified leads
how_it_works.description: Review the tracking setup, privacy notices and applicable consent requirements before installing a visitor tag. Check whether company matches are useful for your target market. Write an internal qualification rule using customer fit, relevant page activity and available intent signals, then have a person validate the account. This suggested rule is an evaluation method, not a verified built-in Diginius scoring formula.

how_it_works.title: Reconcile the client report and invoice
how_it_works.description: Apply the client's agreed management fee or markup to a sample period. Compare the platform calculation and generated invoice with your own calculation. Check whether fees, spend and other figures are clearly labelled in the white-label report, and verify the recipient and review process before sending anything to a client.

how_it_works.title: Decide whether to extend the rollout
how_it_works.description: Before adding more clients, confirm connection reliability, reporting agreement, usable company matches, follow-up ownership and the full commercial quote. Keep the CRM as the record for accepted leads and sales outcomes. Verify any proposed CRM export or integration directly rather than assuming that HubSpot, Salesforce or another connector is included.

limitations.who_it_affects: Agencies promising person-level attribution or a lead for every visit
limitations.mitigation: Company matching is conditional. Do not represent an anonymous visit as a named person, a confirmed sales opportunity or proof of an ad-to-sale journey. Validate the account and keep uncertain matches out of definitive client claims.

limitations.limitation: The agency seat price is not a complete procurement specification
limitations.who_it_affects: Teams budgeting for multiple clients, users and intent-data allowances
limitations.mitigation: Ask for client-account limits, feature inclusions, lead and contact quotas, billing currency, taxes and overage terms. The official pages do not support an unlimited-account claim or the draft's two-user all-feature savings calculation.

limitations.limitation: A simpler reporting setup may be enough
limitations.who_it_affects: Single-channel B2C teams or businesses with no B2B account-research task
limitations.mitigation: If your existing native report answers the client's question, the extra reporting and company-intelligence process may add unnecessary work. Define the decision you cannot make today before selecting another tool.

objection_handling.objection: Will one dashboard solve our attribution disagreements?
objection_handling.response: It can bring reporting into one place, but the team still needs common definitions. Reconcile conversion windows and duplicate credit before using combined CPA or ROAS in a client decision. Ask the vendor to demonstrate your specific reporting scenario rather than assuming all metrics are normalised.

objection_handling.objection: Should we choose a reporting platform or a data connector?
objection_handling.response: Choose around the work your team owns. Compare Diginius for its documented agency and company-intelligence workflow, AgencyAnalytics for your client-reporting needs, and Supermetrics for reporting in your chosen destination. Use the same channels, client count and required outputs for each evaluation; no ranking or hands-on comparison is claimed here.

faq.question: Which advertising channels does Diginius list?
faq.answer: The agency page lists Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Meta and LinkedIn. Confirm the required account types, metrics, refresh schedule and historical coverage for your selected package before you connect client accounts.

faq.question: How does Diginius identify companies visiting a website?
faq.answer: Diginius describes IP-based tracking and company matching where possible, alongside browsing activity. Treat these as company-level research signals. They do not reliably name an individual or independently prove that an ad caused a purchase.

faq.question: How much does the Diginius agency plan cost?
faq.answer: The official agency page lists USD $25 per month, or $240 per year, for each user, checked 14 October 2026. Confirm taxes, billing region, client-account capacity and any separate lead-intelligence requirements. Do not assume a two-seat quote covers every feature or unlimited accounts..

faq.question: Can we use Bombora intent as a finished lead score?
faq.answer: Intent can help prioritise investigation, but it is not a guaranteed buying decision. Agree on a qualification method, check account fit and have the follow-up owner validate each lead. Confirm current Bombora inclusion and allowance periods in the plan quote.

faq.question: Can Diginius replace our CRM?
faq.answer: This evaluation concerns advertising reporting and company-intelligence inputs, not replacing your sales system. Keep lead ownership, sales stages and confirmed revenue in the system your team operates. Verify any required CRM integration or export before buying.

faq.question: Was this review based on hands-on product testing?
faq.answer: No. It uses official vendor documentation checked on 14 October 2026 and an editorial evaluation checklist. It does not claim measured savings, lead accuracy, reporting performance or conversion improvements.
